subject: general
question: Which of the following states first receives the rain from the southwest monsoon?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kerala__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Western Ghats of Kerala**, a coastal state in India, are where the **Arabian Sea Branch** of the **Southwest Monsoon **enters the country, making this area the first to see **rainfall from the monsoon.**
 
• Kera
